notes.title: DEMO REWORK LIVE!
notes.content: [p]It's demo rework day, everyone! You can now install our brand new demo, which is a complete overhaul of the initial weekend in Brine Bay, along with 2 new days![/p][p][/p][p align="start"]We're also LIVE over on [url="https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/lavendeerstudios/threads-of-you-beyond-the-bay"]Kickstarter[/url], if you wish to support us or grab some merch![/p][p][/p][p align="start"]Of course, please let us know if there are any bugs, and we'll get them fixed as fast as we can.[/p][p][/p][p align="start"][b]Welcome back to Brine Bay![/b][/p]

notes.title: DEMO REWORK AND KICKSTARTER COMING SEPTEMBER 23RD!
notes.content: [p]Hey, everyone! [/p][p][/p][p]It's been awhile since we've done an update here, but in case you haven't been keeping up with our socials: We have a demo rework and Kickstarter campaign coming NEXT WEEK on the [b]23rd of September![/b][/p][p][/p][p]Our demo rework is a complete overhaul of 'Threads of You: Beyond the Bay' that better reflects our final product, and you can expect to spend [b]a lot[/b] more time with your beloved boys![/p][p][/p][p]You can follow our [b]Kickstarter[/b] campaign [url="https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/lavendeerstudios/threads-of-you-beyond-the-bay"]here[/url] to be notified [b]as soon[/b] as we go live! [/p][p][/p][p]We can't wait to see everyone back in Brine Bay!  [/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="vPfTctt8UJM;full"][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: LIVE CROWDFUNDING ON KO-FI !
notes.content:
[h2]BIG NEWS EVERYONE!
[/h2]

Due to our country restrictions on Kickstarter, we've decided to host crowdfunding on Ko-Fi instead! 

We'll be able to complete [b]Threads of You: Beyond the Bay[/b] this way! If you're interested in our game, please consider supporting us by spreading word or donating!

[list]
[*] Physical rewards will arrive in late 2024 - early 2025, as we'll need time to produce them!
[*] Digital rewards will arrive within a week! Our full game key will arrive late 2025 - early 2026.
[/list]


[h1][url=https://ko-fi.com/lavendeerstudios/commissions]Click me for donations![/url][/h1]

notes.title: THREADS OF YOU: BEYOND THE BAY DEMO OUT NOW!
notes.content:
[i][b]HAPPY DEMO DAY, EVERYONE!![/b][/i]

Our game demo is now out and available to play on Steam (here!!) and [url=https://lavendeerstudios.itch.io/threads-of-you-beyond-the-bay]itch.io[/url]!

Please report any bugs to us over in our [url=https://discord.gg/lavendeer]Discord[/url] server, have fun!

notes.title: Threads of You: Beyond the Bay demo releases February 22nd!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=KfjBooE44n8;full][/previewyoutube]
Hey everyone! Big news here!

Are you ready to follow the threads of destiny in Brine Bay? Cause we know we are! We hope you're ready to start your journey on [b]February 22nd at 12:30 AM GMT+8[/b]!

Want to play it sooner? If you're a streamer, content creator or reviewer, [url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSczB34p67sWrkJHiPoUMQ-05D5BB5tymV2XOl73IHX5KfdC4w/viewform]click here[/url] to request an early access key! If you're a general fan, consider supporting us on [url=https://www.patreon.com/LavendeerStudios]Patreon[/url] for multiple early access builds! 

Don't forget to wishlist our game to be notified as soon as it becomes public!

[url=https://discord.gg/lavendeer]Join our Discord server[/url] in the meantime to chat with us, other fans and general otome lovers!

Want other news and random fun-facts or content? Follow us on our [url=https://twitter.com/LavendeerStudio]twitter[/url] or catch up with behind-the-scenes information on [url=https://www.patreon.com/LavendeerStudios]Patreon[/url]!
